decisions.reason: GA4 is the mandatory current analytics standard, so the plugin underpins the firm's announced analytics-driven, measurable-results positioning and justifies its development investment.
Universal Analytics has been fully shut down by Google, so no temporary cause can explain its lack of use and sunk costs cannot justify keeping a plugin without a working platform.
The retail system interface reflects the firm's claimed core competence in interface development and supports its full-service integration offer, so slow uptake can still be read as normal ramp-up.
The relaunch SEO service has its own page, is central to the firm's shop-relaunch and marketing positioning, and uses existing staff at little extra cost.

The newly launched SEO workshops are publicly presented on their own page, fit the firm's marketing expertise, and are too young to judge, so weak early results would be attributed to start-up effects.
